ca.uhn.fhir.model.api.IElement, Serializable, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.IAnyResource, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.IBase, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.IBaseHasExtensions, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.IBaseHasModifierExtensions, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.IBaseResource, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.IDomainResource
public class FhirImmunizationRecommendation extends org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.ImmunizationRecommendation
This class is a subclass of ImmunizationRecommendation. Therefore it includes information about vaccination recommendations for patients
It contains functionalities for converting CDA R2 POCDMT000040Entry into HL7 FHIR ImmunizationRecommendation.
